stories.title: Design first slice for codex_provider
stories.description: Write the canonical first-slice design for a sovereign codex_provider in docs/architecture/CODEX_PROVIDER.md. Define scope, auth/session assumptions, and integration points in provider registry, adapter layer, and model preference flow.

stories.title: Add first-pass codex_provider runtime adapter
stories.description: Implement a narrow codex adapter/provider path in sovereign. Keep scope to text/runtime use only. Do not promise tools, vision, or full CLI feature parity yet.

stories.title: Integrate codex_provider with model selection and mandate flows
stories.description: Make provider=model routing and mandates work correctly when the selected provider is codex. Add focused tests so codex becomes a first-class routed backend rather than an ad hoc escape hatch.

stories.title: Make agent-specific backend routing explicit for codex and claude_max
stories.description: Ensure persisted agent preferences map honestly to runtime backend selection, including clear fallback or failure behavior when codex or claude_max is unavailable. Add contract tests around agent-specific routing.

stories.title: Add smoke proof and docs for sovereign codex_provider
stories.description: Add a smoke-proof path and supporting docs showing the current real confidence level for the sovereign codex_provider. Reference the implementation and test artifacts rather than aspirational claims.

stories.title: Add Nellie backend smoke proof for claude_max and codex
stories.description: Create a Nellie-specific proof path for backend pinning across claude_max and codex. Verify persisted preference, active runtime backend, and operator-visible behavior line up.

stories.title: Audit backend status/model honesty across sovereign surfaces
stories.description: Find and fix user-facing or operator-facing backend/model reporting drift in sovereign so status surfaces reflect the active routed provider instead of defaults.
